opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; early‑career postdoctoral researchers; must have completed Viva between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027; not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year award for early‑career researchers to undertake an independent research project leading to a significant publishable output.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers in the humanities or social sciences with a long‑term appointment at a UK university or research organisation; early‑career, mid‑career or senior researchers; must be UK resident.
opportunities.summary: Award of up to £10,000 for 6‑12 months to develop specialist skills, methods or collaborations and disseminate them.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation; must hold a permanent or fixed‑term position; must be able to be relieved from teaching/administrative duties; collaborative interdisciplinary project across Academies’ remits.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding of up to £200,000 for up to 24 months to support interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research across humanities, social sciences, engineering and natural sciences.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher (early‑career to senior) in the humanities or social sciences; must have some public‑engagement experience; cannot have received this award before.
opportunities.summary: Funding of up to £8,000 for innovative public‑engagement projects with a GLAM or performing‑arts partner.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences; must hold an established role at a UK university/research institute; must involve international partners and genuine interdisciplinarity.
opportunities.summary: Awards of up to £300,000 over 24 months for interdisciplinary projects on the theme of Mobilities, involving UK and international collaborators.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career or mid‑career UK‑based researchers in the humanities or social sciences; must be able to be based in Berlin at DGAP for 12 months.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships (up to £150,000) to develop policy‑relevant research and networks in partnership with DGAP.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK or German research institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a three‑day symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’; includes travel, accommodation and seed funding for collaborative projects.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months; must meet eligibility of the target award.
opportunities.summary: Support of up to £4,000 (case‑by‑case) for additional costs such as equipment, caring costs, or assistance to submit applications.
